Return to a previous DSE ERP application version while preserving the current production database and workspace data.
Safe Application Rollback — Keep Current Business Data

A rollback changes the installed application only. Sales, purchases, payments, inventory, customers, suppliers, attachments, issued documents and templates stay in the active workspace. A verified PostgreSQL safety backup is created before installation begins.
Only database-compatible packages can be started. Unknown or incompatible schemas are blocked automatically.
No previous installer retained yet. Use Download Previous Release or Import Previous Installer.
Full Database Recovery is intentionally separate because restoring an older backup can replace transactions entered after that backup.
Every checkpoint must pass before the previous installer starts.
